Keeps you cool in the heat but will make you freeze in the cold.
Snowberries don't need farm plots to grow.
Snowberries can be eaten raw (may make you sick), and are used in various medical items to treat burns, infections and general healing.
Cook Bone Broth from bone, plant fibers and murky water.
It might take awhile before you obtain a cooking pot, but Bone Broth will help keep you fed and hydrated in the meantime without risk of getting sick.
Cook pine cones gathered from pine trees.
While not ideal at all, there are pine nuts inside for when you're desperate to hold back starvation for a little while longer.
Find or build a shelter in the Forest.

The orange bar below your health is your armour, your armour will absorb some of the damage your receive from demons and animals.

Armour doesn't protect you against other forms of damage. You'll know what type of armour you're wearing by the colour, green is 40% protection and blue is 60%. If there is no icon, you have no protection.

Find a structure to take shelter. Be mindful of holes, windows, or doors that will prevent a proper shelter status.
Shelter is needed to recover from biome hazards or for protection against deadly storms.

Another option is to build your own shelter.
Take shelter while in the [DECEA3]Forest[-].
Find or craft some cooking tools.
Without a pot and grill, you'll be very limited on your survival capabilities. You can find them while looting or use a forge to craft your own.
In order to obtain leather, animal hide's need 50 real minutes to cure by placing them on the floor. They'll change colour to let you know they're ready to collect.
Honey won't cure infection, but is used in various cooking recipes and a main ingredient in crafting health potions.

Water has been infected because of the demon invasion, a water purifier will remove most of the harmful effects.\n\nThe best way to get drinking water will be from gathering jars and filling them from sinks, toilets, coolers and water barrels.
Instead of throwing out any seeds you don't want, you can eat them for some a small amount of food.
Bypass the upgrades straight to concrete.
Rebar frames are back baby! Save your wood, cobblestones and bricks by upgrading straight to concrete, without having to wait for it to dry!
Use your forge to craft bricks.
Bricks are used to upgrade cobblestone blocks, to help bridge to upgrade path between cobblestone and concrete.
Fertiliser is back! Did you miss me?
Fertiliser is used to make farm plots as well as gunpowder, so you're gonna need a lot!
Gunpowder can be crafted on your person or at a workbench for an increased price, or at a chemistry station. Crafting gunpowder in stacks of 10,000 will save your even more resources.
Dig up some snow to melt.
Melting snow is also back! Venturing into the snow biome has its risks, but gathering an abundance of snow will help with your glue production and ease off all your water demands.
There is plenty of ammo in Doom: Survival, you can dismantle any unwanted ammo for a 30% gunpowder loss, allowing you to make the ammo you do want.
Craft Acid from a Car Battery.
If you are lacking in Acid but have an abundance in car batteries, you can use a Chemistry Station to extract the acid from batteries.
Notes are used to purchase items from vending machines.
You'll find plenty of notes in cash registers and ATM's.\n\nYou can also craft money in the chemistry station.
Gather various weapons throughout the world.
You're not going to be able to do much with just a Handgun and Pump Shotgun. You're going to have to explore the other biomes if you wish to collect 'em all.
Find treasure maps to find treasure locations.
Before people evacuated the Earth, some left behind their prized possessions. Make sure to bring lockpicks or timed charges!
Spend an hour in the Burnt Forest.

The demons are all over the place, even in the Burnt Forest. Rip and Tear while you're exploring, oh, and bring something to drink!.\n\nYou might find some gear that can only be found in the Burnt Forest.
Spend an hour in the Desert.
The demons are here in the desert too! Make sure you're got plenty to drink! You know what to do, Rip and Tear!\n\nYou might find some gear that can only be found in the Desert.
Spend an hour in the Snow.
The demons don't seem to be bothered about the cold, unfortunately for you, being cold makes your body burn your food reserves.\n\nYou might find some gear that can only be found in the Snow.
Spend an hour in the Wasteland.
The Wasteland is a deadly place, if you go in without any protective gear, you will perish within seconds!\n\nYou might find UAC's most advanced weaponry in the Wasteland.

Former Humans know how to use guns, they can shred you and your armour fast if you're not careful.
Imps are the lessor demons of the Hell Spawn, they do minimal damage and their fireballs are easy to dodge.
Nightmare Imps are faster and more resilient than regular Imps, their fireballs are also faster than regular Imps.
Massacre Hundreds of Pinkies and Spectres.
Pinkies and Spectres don't have any ranged attack, but move very fast to catch their target.
Kill Lost Souls and Baby Cacodemons.
Massacre Hundreds of Lost Souls and Baby Cacodemons.

Lost Souls are fast in the air and constantly burn, making it easy to hear them coming towards you. Baby Cacodemons typically spit their fireballs from a distance, sometimes they fly in to bite their target.
Fully grown Cacodemons are slower than their children, but are more resilient and deal more damage.
Pain Elementals spit Lost Souls and can quickly overwhelm their target by surrounding them with their children.
Hell Knights are an intermediate demon, more threatening than a Nightmare Imp, but using the same strategy works just as well to deal with them.
Massacre Hundreds of Barons of Hell.
Barons of Hell are one of the biggest baddest demons, they are the bigger brother of the Hell Knight and are much harder to kill.
Revenants are the glass cannon of the demons

Archviles have an aura around them that is capable of igniting their target on fire if they manage to get in range. Keep your distance at all costs!

The demon invasion has had a devastating effect on some of Earth's animals
column3: making them far more dangerous than they already were.
